review.notes: All 16 full bilingual entries read. Dissection wording and milk-production/one-product request corrected and reread. Native ItemDeliveryQuest crop branch inspected: all three random request prefixes combine with all three produce suffixes and optional delivery/payment endings. Explicit neuter προϊόν keeps these combinations grammatical; nominative/accusative forms are identical. Demetrius receives a crop sample for biological research, Marnie feeds goats/cows, and Sebastian’s mountain-throwing request preserves its mood and address. Original newlines and signature spacing retained.

records.source: Could a local farmer deliver one to me?
records.translation: Μπορεί κάποιος ντόπιος αγρότης να μου φέρει ένα;

records.source: I'll pay you when you bring it.
records.translation: Θα σε πληρώσω όταν το φέρεις.

records.source: I would be so happy if someone delivered one to me.
records.translation: Θα χαιρόμουν πολύ αν κάποιος μου έφερνε ένα.

records.source:
Greetings! Demetrius here. Could someone please bring me {0}?

records.source: Howdy neighbors! My goats are really hankerin' for {0}. I can't find any myself! Help?     -Marnie
records.translation: Γεια χαρά, γείτονες! Οι κατσίκες μου έχουν τρελή λαχτάρα για «{0}». Δεν μπορώ να βρω πουθενά! Καμιά βοήθεια;     -Μάρνι

records.source: Howdy neighbors! I want to try giving my cows {0} to increase their milk production. If you find one could you swing it by for me?.     -Marnie
records.translation: Γεια χαρά, γείτονες! Θέλω να δοκιμάσω να δώσω στις αγελάδες μου «{0}» για να αυξηθεί η παραγωγή γάλακτος. Αν βρεις ένα τέτοιο προϊόν, μπορείς να μου το φέρεις;     -Μάρνι

records.source: Feeling gloomy... {0} might cheer me up.     -Sebastian
records.translation: Έχω τις μαύρες μου... Ίσως κάτι όπως «{0}» να μου φτιάξει τη διάθεση.     -Σεμπάστιαν

records.source: ...feel like throwing {0} as hard as I can against the mountain face. Please deliver to Sebastian at 24 Mountain Road.
